name: cyclesense-platform
description: CycleSense — Adult Women Track & Understand. A MERN women's health platform.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev:memory" "npm --prefix client run dev"
